title: Example: the rower's hand
message: He saw them the whole time.

shots.words: They rowed for hours and barely moved.
shots.picture: A tiny boat on black water, seen from far above
shots.why: Starting close and pulling away makes the boat shrink as the sea grows
shots.acting: The rowers strain on 'rowed' and don't gain ground

shots.picture: A lone figure on the hillside, turned toward the far water
shots.why: A slow push makes the look feel deliberate
shots.acting: His head turns toward the water on 'saw'

shots.words: He saw them the whole time.
shots.picture: The same tiny boat from far above, with one small light far behind it
shots.understand: The opening picture means something new
shots.why: The opening frame returns, changed by one small light
shots.acting: The rowers keep straining, and the light holds steady
